title: About the app
description: Your go-to app for exploring the world's most popular cuisines with an Arabic twist. The app combines the vast database of TheMealDB with the intelligence of instant translation, providing you with the most accurate details and ingredients in a modern and stylish design.
feature1_desc: Explore thousands of recipes from around the world thanks to TheMealDB integration.
feature2_desc: Get highly accurate translated recipes using the Google Translate API.
feature3_desc: Elegant and user-friendly interface with support for dark and light mode.
feature4_desc: Save your favorite recipes for later use without having to search for them again.
